avr.text: Javy, a Wojek investigator, leads Relov to a tenement where Zivan's corpse lies with words carved into every inch of his skin, and she warns that someone is slaughtering Azorius in the manner in which they lived their lives.
She shows him an old Mass Arrest Order for the Golgari raid and points out that everyone who signed it is dead except him.
At midnight she visits his townhouse and tells him she has found a new teacher, and when Vraska enters, Javy warns Relov not to look at her face.
Vraska lets Javy choose Relov's death, and she names inaction.
